ThreeJam

A 2D game engine on Three.js where your coding agent proves what its game does.

  • GitHub
  • npm
  • Docs

Example games

Each game is one HTML file from threejam export, and each picture is a frame threejam shot draws at a fixed seed and tick. Every game plays with a keyboard, or on a phone or tablet with its on-screen keys.

  • Pong

    Two players at one keyboard, first to 7 points.

    W and S move the left paddle, Up and Down the right; Space starts.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

  • Breakout

    Clear every brick with three lives.

    Left and Right, or A and D, move the paddle; Space serves.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

  • Snake

    Eat apples to grow, and don't hit a wall or yourself.

    An arrow key starts the snake, and the arrow keys turn it; Space plays again.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

  • Flappy

    Flap through the gaps between the pipes.

    Space starts a run, and each press flaps.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

  • Invaders

    Clear the wave before the invaders reach the bottom.

    Left and Right move the cannon; Space starts and fires, and holding it keeps firing.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

  • Tetris

    Fill rows to clear them, until a new piece has no room.

    Left and Right move the piece, Up rotates it, and Down drops it faster; Space starts.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

  • Asteroids

    Shoot the rocks, which split when hit, and don't let them hit you.

    Left and Right turn, Up thrusts, and Space fires; or hold the mouse, or a finger on the game, to aim and fire, and the right button to thrust. Space, a click, or a tap on the game starts.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

  • Racer

    Weave through traffic to the finish line before the clock runs out, on 2D rules drawn in 3D.

    Left and Right steer, and Space starts. A crash spins the car out, and each coin adds a second.

    Keyboard or on-screen keysCode

What each game shows

Make your own

Install ThreeJam in your project:

npm install -D threejam

Give your coding agent the skill that teaches it to build and test games with ThreeJam:

npx skills add https://github.com/aksheyd/threejam/tree/v0.0.7/skills/threejam

Or register ThreeJam's MCP server with your coding agents, so they get the same commands as tools:

npx threejam mcp add
